description: Check an x402 payment challenge BEFORE your agent pays (0.002 USDC per check via x402; free trial 1024 checks/IP/UTC day). Give an endpoint URL (fetched unpaid, never paid) or paste a 402 challenge. Validates x402 version, scheme, network (CAIP-2, testnet flag), canonical USDC asset, amount sanity, payTo format/EIP-55 checksum/zero address, EIP-712 domain, payment window, facilitator reachability and scheme/network support, optional maxPriceUsd / expectPayTo / expectNetwork policy, and PayAI Bazaar listing match. Returns per-check pass/warn/fail and a verdict: looks_ok, review or do_not_pay. Informational; invalid input and failed checks are not charged.

challenge.description: Alternative to url: the 402 challenge itself (JSON body, or the base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header value). Takes precedence over url.

compareDirectory.description: Compare live terms with the PayAI Bazaar listing (url mode)

expectNetwork.description: Policy: fail options not on this network (CAIP-2, e.g. eip155:8453)

expectPayTo.description: Policy: fail options whose payTo differs from this address

facilitator.description: Facilitator base URL to test (https). Default: PayAI (mainnet) / x402.org (testnet).

maxPriceUsd.description: Policy: fail options priced above this many USD (USDC)

method.description: HTTP method used to probe url

url.description: x402 endpoint URL to probe (public http/https). Fetched unpaid; never paid.
